proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features checked dimensionless under V->2V, L->3L (T->1.5T): 1/T ratios, (L/T)/(L/T), (L^3/T^3)/(L^3/T^3). Denominators strictly >0 in interior (omega>0, eps*d>0 for d>0, sqrt(k)>=0) so finite except possibly exact wall d=0 which is <1% of points like accepted f_pgwall. No direct target leakage (no tau_dev/k alone). Dropping 3 zero-gain/zero-use features frees search capacity without hurting heldout.
